The teams went into the break with everything to play for. Anderlecht's Second Half Surge The home side came out of the tunnel with renewed energy, taking control of the match immediately. Just two minutes into the second half, in the 47th minute, Lukas Ambros restored Anderlecht 's lead, with Giulian Biancone providing his second assist of the night. The pressure didn't stop there. In the 55th minute, Danylo Sikan capitalized on a ball from Mihajlo Cvetkovic to make it 3-1, putting the Belgian side in a commanding position. Late Penalty and Red Card Chaos As the clock ticked down, the atmosphere grew increasingly tense. PAOK were thrown a lifeline in the 88th minute when they were awarded a penalty, which Alexander Jeremejeff converted with composure. However, the comeback attempt quickly unraveled. Andrija Zivkovic was shown a straight red card in the 89th minute, followed by Alexander Jeremejeff receiving his marching orders in the 93rd minute amidst heavy protests. Despite a late yellow card for Nathan Saliba , Anderlecht secured the 3-2 victory in a frantic finish.
